# Theme brief: Swadesi Mangoes

Page: `/web-design/swadesi-mangoes/`. Tokens are in that page's `style.css`.
No brand kit was collected. Colors and fonts below are read from the live store screenshot.

- Colors: mango orange `#E8892B` (menu links and logo; shapes only, fails AA as small text), leaf green `#12850A`
  (banner and panels, white text on it passes AA), dark green ink `#1E2A16`, cream page `#FFFCF3`. Links `#0E6C08`.
- Fonts (closest Google Fonts): Kalam 700 for display (the live site uses a bold handwritten italic), Cabin for body and menus.
- Logo: `img/logo.webp` (cropped from the live site: orange S with a green leaf, "SwaDesi Mangoes").
- Motifs: a wall of ripe yellow-green mangoes, green banner strip ("Accepting orders for 2026 Season"),
  rounded green story panel, WhatsApp chat button. Farm-fresh and family-run.
- Motion ideas: mangoes tumble in and settle; a leaf sways on the logo; the green panel slides up over the photo.
- Images in `img/`: site (live store screenshot), logo, thumb. The owner has not confirmed the live store runs his rebuild,
  so the caption says so. Repo logos (public/logo.png, swami-logo.png) are in the client repo, not copied.
